findings.evidenceJa: 全ての針が頂点を指す
findings.governingReading: Every hand points to the top of the clock at the appointed instant.
findings.explanation: The English replaces the visual convergence of all hands with an audible clock strike.

findings.evidenceJa: 遠坂に言われたペンダント
findings.governingReading: The pendant is the one object Rin told Shirou to bring.
findings.explanation: The English retains the object but removes Rin’s instruction and its planned role.

findings.evidenceJa: イリヤに残ってもらうのは俺の希望
findings.governingReading: Having Illya remain behind is also Shirou’s own wish or preference.
findings.explanation: The English makes Illya herself his hope, changing a concrete protective decision into an abstract emotional role.

findings.evidenceJa: 夜が明ける頃に
findings.governingReading: Illya asks them to return around the time dawn breaks.
findings.explanation: The English turns an approximate reunion time into a before-dawn deadline.

findings.highlight: If we want the Great Holy Grail
findings.evidenceJa: 聖杯戦争の大聖杯に行こう
findings.governingReading: Rin says that to go to the Holy Grail War’s Greater Grail, they must descend.
findings.explanation: The English changes a destination into wanting possession of the Greater Grail.

findings.evidenceJa: 山の中へ入っていく
findings.governingReading: They enter the mountain interior relying on moonlight.
findings.explanation: The English adds upward travel and loses movement into the mountain.

findings.highlight: Following the sound of water, I figure out which direction to search
findings.evidenceJa: 水の音を頼りに目を凝らす
findings.governingReading: Using the sound as a guide, Shirou strains his eyes to see.
findings.explanation: The English replaces active visual scrutiny with deciding a search direction.

findings.highlight: a huge boulder is blocking the entrance
findings.evidenceJa: 中に入ったところですぐに岩にぶつかる
findings.governingReading: At a glance, anyone entering would appear to hit rock almost immediately inside.
findings.explanation: The English relocates and enlarges the obstruction into a huge boulder blocking the entrance itself.

findings.highlight: The sound of scraping on a hard surface
findings.evidenceJa: かつん、という音
findings.governingReading: The descent begins with a single hard “katsun” click or knock.
findings.explanation: The English changes a discrete impact into continuous scraping.

findings.evidenceJa: 淡々と奈落へと降りていく
findings.governingReading: They descend steadily and impassively into the abyss.
findings.explanation: The English removes both the abyss image and their emotionally controlled manner.

findings.highlight: we’re over a hundred meters underground
findings.evidenceJa: 百メートル以上は進んだ
findings.governingReading: By bodily sensation Shirou judges that they have traveled more than one hundred meters.
findings.explanation: The English changes distance traveled into vertical depth underground.

findings.evidenceJa: あまりにも生々しい
findings.governingReading: The overflowing life force feels viscerally raw and immediate.
findings.explanation: The English turns disturbing rawness into mere liveliness, weakening the horror of excessive life.

findings.highlight: something rotten, making me want to look away
findings.evidenceJa: 目を背けたくなる汚物
findings.governingReading: The warmth of life has become filth from which Shirou wants to avert his eyes.
findings.explanation: The English substitutes decay or rot, changing revulsion at excessive life into imagery of decomposition.

findings.evidenceJa: 意識が切れる
findings.governingReading: If Shirou relaxes, his consciousness cuts out.
findings.explanation: The English makes the loss gradual rather than abrupt.

findings.highlight: A warm wind hits my cheeks
findings.evidenceJa: 生暖かい風が頬を撫でる
findings.governingReading: A lukewarm, unpleasantly bodylike wind strokes Shirou’s cheek.
findings.explanation: The English normalizes the temperature and changes a caress into blunt impact.

findings.evidenceJa: 忘れられた地下の広間
findings.governingReading: The cavern is a forgotten underground hall resembling a lunar wasteland.
findings.explanation: The English directly reverses “forgotten” into “unforgettable.”

findings.evidenceJa: 絶対の殺気
findings.governingReading: Saber waits wrapped in absolute killing intent.
findings.explanation: The English softens a certain lethal orientation into general hostility.

findings.evidenceJa: 間違いで私に剣を向けないように
findings.governingReading: Saber warns Rin not to point her sword at Saber by mistake.
findings.explanation: The English removes the mistaken-action condition and generalizes pointing a sword into attacking.

findings.evidenceJa: わたしは信頼してるんだから
findings.governingReading: Rin deliberately leaves the object of her trust unspoken while urging Shirou to meet her expectation.
findings.explanation: The English fills the withheld object with Shirou, resolving an intentionally awkward and emotionally guarded line.

findings.evidenceJa: 振り返らずに遠坂は奥へと消えていった
findings.governingReading: Rin proceeds into the depths without turning back.
findings.explanation: The English removes both her refusal to look back and the direction of departure.

findings.evidenceJa: セイバーの殺気が膨れ上がる
findings.governingReading: Saber’s killing intent swells once Rin has gone.
findings.explanation: The English again softens imminent lethal intent into hostility.

findings.highlight: just like when I fought Berserker
findings.evidenceJa: バーサーカーを打倒した時と同じく
findings.governingReading: Shirou turns to Projection as he did when he defeated Berserker.
findings.explanation: The English removes the earlier victory that makes the tactic seem available against Saber.

findings.highlight: protect the senses from the headwind!
findings.evidenceJa: 意識がされる。切断てあしを、感覚、思考だけは、この逆風から守り抜く！
findings.governingReading: The Japanese presents ruptured cognition whose fragments retain severance, limbs, sensation, and thought under the counterflow.
findings.explanation: The English preserves gaps but drops thought as a protected faculty and recomposes the fragments into a more directed imperative.

findings.highlight: concentrate everything I have in my left arm
findings.evidenceJa: 意識の全てを左腕に注ぎ込んで
findings.governingReading: Shirou pours all of his consciousness into his left arm.
findings.explanation: The English broadens the resource into everything he has and loses the cognition/body-control mechanism.

findings.highlight: her sword lunges to pierce my throat
findings.evidenceJa: 視認さえさせず俺の喉を突きに来る
findings.governingReading: Saber’s sword thrusts for Shirou’s throat without even allowing him to see it.
findings.explanation: The English preserves target and action but removes its imperceptible speed.

findings.evidenceJa: もっと長く、もっと強く、このままセイバーと戦っていられる
findings.governingReading: Drawing further would let him continue fighting Saber longer and more strongly.
findings.explanation: The English removes both comparative duration and increasing strength, flattening the temptation driving him past his limit.

findings.evidenceJa: 離した間合いは十メートル
findings.governingReading: The resulting interval between the fighters is ten meters.
findings.explanation: The English says Shirou’s jump itself covered exactly ten meters, confusing final range with movement distance.

findings.highlight: How can you say that, knowing your condition?
findings.evidenceJa: その体でよく吠える
findings.governingReading: Saber contemptuously says he barks boldly for someone in that body.
findings.explanation: The English explains the contradiction literally and removes her animalizing taunt.

findings.highlight: with the swords I have right now
findings.evidenceJa: 唯一許されたこの投影で
findings.governingReading: Shirou believes he must defeat Saber using the single remaining Projection permitted to him.
findings.explanation: The English replaces his reserved final Projection with the swords already in his hands, breaking the resource logic that Saber challenges next.

findings.evidenceJa: 自分のものでなくなった心
findings.governingReading: Shirou’s heart is no longer his own alongside a body without sensation.
findings.explanation: The English changes alienation of the heart into a mind that lacks any self, escalating figurative estrangement into ontological absence.

findings.evidenceJa: 鉄塊をも撃ち砕く
findings.governingReading: A single Noble Phantasm blow can smash even a mass of iron.
findings.explanation: The English changes blunt destructive force and an iron mass into penetration of steel.

findings.evidenceJa: 未来予知じみた勘の良さ
findings.governingReading: Saber’s extraordinarily sharp instinct resembles precognition.
findings.explanation: The English says “cognition-like,” losing the future-sight comparison and producing an incoherent modifier.

findings.highlight: she blocks it with her sword
findings.evidenceJa: 敵の剣の前に砕かれた
findings.governingReading: Bakuya is shattered against or before Saber’s sword.
findings.explanation: The English records only a block and removes destruction of the frontal sword, which is required for the weapon accounting.

findings.highlight: She even blocks my final attack
findings.evidenceJa: 最後の一撃さえ、この敵は打ち砕いた
findings.governingReading: The enemy shatters even the last Kanshou strike.
findings.explanation: The English reduces weapon destruction to blocking, again obscuring the state needed for the next Projection.

findings.evidenceJa: 両雄、共ニ命ヲ別ツ
findings.governingReading: The written line has the two heroes part with life together, while its ruby reads “we do not embrace heaven together.”
findings.explanation: The mature English branch states the opposite of the ruby by making them embrace heaven together.

findings.highlight: A hero is someone who cuts down his foes using everything he has
findings.evidenceJa: あらゆる努力、あらゆる犠牲をしいて挑む敵を、息を吸うが如く斬り伏せるのが英雄
findings.governingReading: A hero cuts down as easily as breathing the enemies who challenge him after imposing every effort and sacrifice on themselves.
findings.explanation: The English assigns “using everything he has” to the hero instead of the desperate challengers and removes the effortless-breathing comparison.
